description: Five app-input goals for the assistant (docs/design/app-inputs.md 13.3, 23, 26, 29). Kept out of eval-goals.json, which is the pinned 50-goal recipe-first gate (check-eval-goals.mjs and AssistantEvalHarnessTests require exactly 50 goals and a closed set of routes). Each goal's expected.score is what the scorer checks (AppInputEvalScoring in inference/tests/.../AssistantEval): the proposal tool, the app-page operations (aliases link a field to the binding that uses it), Apply, and the must-nots. Check the fixture with node docs/design/workflow-apps/check-app-input-eval-goals.mjs; the scorer's own tests run with dotnet test --filter AppInputEvalScoringTests. No paid run has been made. The switch Workflows:AppInputs:Enabled must be on.

goals.goal: Make an app where my team types the video idea and picks the shape.
goals.context: A project with a workflow that has one VideoGenerate step (Inline prompt) and no app page of its own.

patchOps: setAppInput: a longText field (the video idea), required, with an example
bindAppInput: the VideoGenerate step's inlinePrompt to {{input.<id>}}
setAppInput: a shape field offering the shapes the step's model makes
bindAppInput: appInputs.ratio of the same step
mustNot: show an id in the reply

goals.goal: Add a cheaper mode to this app.
goals.context: An app with a full VideoGenerate branch and a cheaper model of the same capability in the workspace.

patchOps: setAppInput: a toggle field (Lite mode / cheaper), default off
a Conditional step reading input.<id> that picks the cheaper branch, the other branch finishing with "end"
alternates: clarify_first: ask what may be cheaper (model, length, takes) when nothing obvious is
mustNot: add a tool call outside the closed set

goals.goal: Let people choose the video model, recommend the cheapest.
goals.context: An app with one VideoGenerate step and three selectable video models of different price.

patchOps: setAppInput: a model field of capability VideoGeneration, more: true, recommended = the option with the lowest costIndex
bindAppInput: appInputs.@model of the VideoGenerate step
mustNot: quote a price in credits or money for a model

goals.goal: Run the avatar clip in Lite mode saying 'Welcome to Caffè Lume'.
goals.context: A project with avatar-clip created from the recipe and one consented avatar.

expected.card: lists Lite mode (cheaper) and What they say by label, and prices only the Lite path

goals.goal: Remove the music volume field from this app.
goals.context: A workflow made from video-derush-edit-music with the app-input edition (musicVolume under More options).

patchOps: removeAppInput: musicVolume (the step's musicGainDb goes back to a fixed value)
